info.name: UBC Abacus Dataverse Access Datasets API

description.content: OpenAPI 3.0 description of the Dataverse REST API exposed by UBC Library's Abacus research-data repository (Dataverse 5.9). Spec retrieved live from https://abacus.library.ubc.ca/openapi. Native Dataverse Search and Data Access APIs are available for read; write operations require an API token.
